concept: RDS Read Replicas + ElastiCache: offloading reads from the DB
tests: Which two changes most effectively cut RDS read load from repeated queries.
expected: ElastiCache (in-memory cache for repeated identical queries) + RDS read replicas (spread read traffic). Triggers: "read-heavy", "repeated identical queries", "growing read traffic", (Choose two).
why_not: Moving to Single-AZ lowers availability and doesn't help reads; backup retention doesn't affect read performance.
